headword: {商|しょう}{売|ばい}{繁|はん}{盛|じょう}
reading: しょうばいはんじょう

definitions.gloss: prosperous business; thriving trade; flourishing commerce
definitions.explanation: A business doing well, with plenty of customers and sales. A set phrase strongly associated with good-luck charms and prayers for commercial success.

examples.japanese: {商|しょう}{売|ばい}{繁|はん}{盛|じょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祈|いの}る→祈る：01198_inoru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{商|しょう}{売|ばい}{繁|はん}{盛|じょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご{利益|りやく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: This shrine is famous for its blessing of business prosperity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{店先|みせさき}→店先：20728_misesaki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{招|まね}き{猫|ねこ}→招き猫：06538_manekineko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}って→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧、{商|しょう}{売|ばい}{繁|はん}{盛|じょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{願|ねが}った→願う：02387_negau⟧。
examples.english: They placed a beckoning cat at the storefront, wishing for a thriving business.

notes:
A fixed four-character phrase used mainly in the context of prayers, charms, and good wishes for a store or company. Often seen on ⟦{縁起物|えんぎもの}→縁起物：15731_engimono⟧ (lucky charms) and shrine {お札|ふだ} (talismans).
